exposure: DVI with adjunctive sweeping of membranes (ASM)
outcome: Need for additional ripening with dinoprostone vaginal tablets
cohort: 208 women with singleton term pregnancies, cervical dilation ≥1 and <3 cm, intact membranes
finding: DVI with ASM was found to be at least as efficacious as DVI alone for cervical ripening, with no increase in morbidity, although it did not significantly impact the duration of labor or mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Although the duration of labor was similar between groups, DVI with ASM did not significantly impact mode of delivery.
